verdict.summary_en: Hwaseong Memory advises a short shipment on PO 4500318735 for CMP-GAM-001 (Game Card 128 GB – Grand Heist 6). Of 48,000 pcs ordered, 28,000 pcs (5 of 7 ULDs) were flown ICN–FRA on AWB 020-48113256. The carrier offloaded 2 ULDs for capacity reasons. The balance of 20,000 pcs is planned for the 2026-11-23 flight, with delivery to Hamburg on 2026-11-24.
red_flags: Short shipment: 28,000 of 48,000 pcs shipped; 20,000 pcs balance outstanding.
Balance delivery to Hamburg is only planned (next available flight 2026-11-23, delivery 2026-11-24) and is not confirmed.
Cause given is carrier offloading (capacity), 2 of 7 ULDs.

ULD counts do not match the quantities if the ULDs were loaded evenly. 28,000 pcs on 5 ULDs is 5,600 per ULD, which would make 7 ULDs about 39,200 pcs, not 48,000. The 2 offloaded ULDs would hold 11,200 pcs, not 20,000. Loads may be uneven, so this needs checking with the supplier.
The document gives no document number, and the delivery date for the shipped 28,000 pcs is not stated.
observations: Clean typed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The page mixes Korean and English. The Korean column headers are 발주수량 (ordered), 출하수량 (shipped) and 잔량 (balance).
Numbers use English comma thousands separators (48,000 = 48000).
The shipping date is given only as 'today', and the document header is dated 2026-11-21.
